names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 octombrie, «Sfântul Filotei I (Kokkinos), Patriarhul Constantinopolului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Φιλόθεος ο Κόκκινος Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης», with the rank words left off; the epithet «ο Κόκκινος» is the page's own.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Născut în jurul anului 1300, în Tesalonic». The bounds are the page's own „about 1300” and nothing narrower.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «A părăsit tronul ecumenic în anul 1376, din pricina bătrâneții, şi a adormit trei ani mai târziu, în anul 1379.»

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

feast.note: doxologia.ro's life also keeps his memory on the fifth Sunday of Great Lent — «Pomenirea lui se face în Duminica a 5-a a Postului Mare şi pe 11 Octombrie» — a moveable day that is not recorded here; 11 octombrie is the fixed day the calendar prints.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 11 octombrie — «Sfântul Filotei I (Kokkinos), Patriarhul Constantinopolului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Φιλόθεος ο Κόκκινος Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the learned cleric of a notable Thessalonican family, champion of the hesychast teaching of Gregory Palamas, abbot of the Great Lavra during the hesychast controversies, signatory of the Hagioritic Tome of 1339, metropolitan of Herakleia in Thrace from 1347 and a member of the great synod of Constantinople of 1351. The page gives those years but no year of birth or death, so no `dates` object is proposed, and it prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The same day keeps Germanus Maroules, whose life Philotheus wrote, drafted as a new folder in batch el-10-11.
